title: Sparkling Water 12-pack

drivers.name: 20% off promotion
drivers.evidence: Past promotions show noise-adjusted median lift of x1.83. The June 29 event had a 20% off + holiday, producing x3.5. This week has the same discount but no holiday, so a lower lift is expected. Shrink from 1.83 to 1.60 to account for missing holiday. Adjusted effect: +60%.

adjustment.analysis: The 20% off promotion is similar to the June 29 Independence Day event, which drove a 3.5x lift. However, that week had a major holiday. The noise-adjusted uplift from 8 past promotions is 1.83, but this week lacks a comparable holiday. The product has no recent price change history; the 20% discount is new and deeper than usual. The baseline trend shows strong seasonal ramp (77.4% 13-week trend). Given the price drop and promotion, but no holiday, a conservative adjustment is warranted. The classical model’s 1.83 is too aggressive without holiday context. Shrink toward 1.0 due to novelty and lack of holiday. The post-promo effect (0.96) is not relevant this week.
